    require(t.ndim==1 and len(t)>=2 and np.isfinite(t).all() and (np.diff(t)>0).all(),"capture needs finite increasing measured sample times")
    require(pos.shape == (len(t),len(names),3) and quat.shape == (len(t),len(names),4), "XML/capture body order mismatch")
    source = dict(repository="https://github.com/yly-true/fudan_rl_wheel_leg", commit=FUDAN_COMMIT,
                  artifact_path=str(npz_path), artifact_sha256=producer_receipt.get("artifact_sha256"),
                  body_order_source="pinned_include_free_MJCF_preorder_plus_world",
                  quaternion="wxyz", wheel_order=["left","right"],
                  foreign_transitions_for_native_world_model=False,
                  original_case=case_summary["case"], capture_complete=True,
                  contact_threshold_n=float(normal_contact_threshold_n),
                  source_jump_validation=producer_receipt.get("source_jump_validation", "pending"),
                  not_our_step270_success=True)
    clock = dict(time_basis="measured_simulation_time_s", **case_summary["model_timestep"],
                 source_sample_dt_min_s=float(np.diff(t).min()), source_sample_dt_max_s=float(np.diff(t).max()))
    data = dict(schema=SCHEMA,source=source,clock=clock,time_s=t.tolist(),
                chassis_position_m=pos[:,ids[0]].tolist(),chassis_quaternion_wxyz=quat[:,ids[0]].tolist(),
                wheel_center_m=pos[:,ids[1:]].tolist(),wheel_bottom_world_z_m=bottom.tolist(),
                wheel_contact=(contact > normal_contact_threshold_n).tolist(),
                provenance_kind="measured_original_robot_reference")
    return TaskspaceDemo.from_dict(data)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RetargetTaskspace:
    time_s: np.ndarray
    root_position_m: np.ndarray
    root_quaternion_wxyz: np.ndarray
    wheel_local_m: np.ndarray
    wheel_contact: np.ndarray
    contact_phase: tuple[str,...]
    metadata: dict


def retarget_taskspace(demo, own_nominal_wheel_local_m, own_root_start_m,
                       target_heading_rad=0., target_control_dt_s=.01,
                       start_s=None, end_s=None,limb_excursion_attenuation=1.):
    """Preserve observed motion; scale relative limb excursions using each robot's rest geometry.

    No added forward travel, step rise, root impulse, gate, action, or joint-angle copy.
    A flat standing jump therefore remains a flat standing jump reference, with explicit
    task-coverage pending; it is never relabeled a successful 270 mm step demonstration.
    """
    own_wheel = array(own_nominal_wheel_local_m,(2,3),"own wheel rest geometry")
    own_root = array(own_root_start_m,(3,),"own root start")
    require(np.isfinite(limb_excursion_attenuation) and 0<limb_excursion_attenuation<=1,
            "limb excursion attenuation must be explicit in (0,1]")
    d = demo.resample(target_control_dt_s,start_s,end_s)
    r = quat_to_mat(d.chassis_quaternion_wxyz)
    local = np.einsum("tji,twj->twi",r,d.wheel_center_m-d.chassis_position_m[:,None,:])
    source_leg = float(np.linalg.norm(local[0][:,[0,2]],axis=-1).mean())
    target_leg = float(np.linalg.norm(own_wheel[:,[0,2]],axis=-1).mean())
    require(source_leg > 0 and target_leg > 0, "zero baseline leg geometry")
    leg_scale = target_leg/source_leg
    source_span = abs(local[0,0,1]-local[0,1,1]); own_span = abs(own_wheel[0,1]-own_wheel[1,1])
    require(source_span > 0 and own_span > 0, "zero wheel track width")
    scale = np.array([leg_scale, own_span/source_span, leg_scale])
    wheels = own_wheel+(local-local[0])*scale*limb_excursion_attenuation
    source_yaw = math.atan2(r[0,1,0],r[0,0,0])
    angle = float(target_heading_rad)-source_yaw
    c,s = math.cos(angle),math.sin(angle)
    align = np.array([[c,-s,0],[s,c,0],[0,0,1]])
    # Scale in the source heading frame, then rotate into the target heading.
    # Scaling after world-frame rotation would break heading equivariance.
    sc,ss=math.cos(source_yaw),math.sin(source_yaw)
    source_heading=np.array([[sc,-ss,0],[ss,sc,0],[0,0,1]])
    tc,ts=math.cos(target_heading_rad),math.sin(target_heading_rad)
    target_heading=np.array([[tc,-ts,0],[ts,tc,0],[0,0,1]])
    root=own_root+((d.chassis_position_m-d.chassis_position_m[0])@source_heading*scale)@target_heading.T
    rotation = align@r
    phases = tuple("both_supported" if a and b else "flight" if not (a or b)
                   else "left_supported" if a else "right_supported" for a,b in d.wheel_contact)
    metadata = dict(schema="mod4.supermimic.taskspace_retarget.v1", source=d.source,
                    source_clock=d.clock,target_control_dt_s=float(target_control_dt_s),
                    source_baseline_leg_m=source_leg,target_baseline_leg_m=target_leg,
                    scale_xyz=scale.tolist(),body_angle_copy=False,foreign_action_copy=False,
                    limb_excursion_attenuation=float(limb_excursion_attenuation),
                    source_motion_preserved_no_synthetic_step_or_forward_displacement=True,
                    closed_chain_IK="pending", dynamic_actuation_feasibility="pending",
                    H1_dualwheel270mm_cross_topcontact_200callback_recovery="not_demonstrated",
                    provenance_kind=d.provenance_kind,
                    reference_role="partial_jump_shape_reference",
                    task_coverage=dict(source_jump="pending_source_validation",H1_step270=False,
                                       H1_forward_arrival=False,H1_top_contact_and_recovery=False),
                    native_frame_zero_reference_time_s=0.)
    return RetargetTaskspace(d.time_s-d.time_s[0],root,continuous_quat(mat_to_quat(rotation)),
                            wheels,d.wheel_contact,phases,metadata)


class NativeReference:
    """Reference-only 73-state tensor/NumPy loader with explicit native joint-name mapping.

    The caller supplies a complete own-robot kinematic clip. A pending/failed solve,
    synthetic fixture, or unverified SDK order cannot be used for production goals.
    Target velocities are derivatives of retargeted states, not foreign qvel/actions.
    """
    def __init__(self, times_s, packed73, joint_names, metadata, *, allow_fixture=False):
        t=np.asarray(times_s,dtype=float); n=len(t)
        require(t.shape==(n,) and n>=2 and np.isfinite(t).all() and np.all(np.diff(t)>0), "bad native times")
        states=array(packed73,(n,73),"native packed73")
        require(len(joint_names)==30 and len(set(joint_names))==30, "30 unique native joint names required")
        require(metadata.get("kinematic_pose_contract") == "passed_for_all_exported_frames", "kinematic reference pending/failed")
        require(metadata.get("foreign_transitions_for_native_world_model") is False, "reference may not seed WM dynamics")
        if not allow_fixture:
            require(metadata.get("provenance_kind") == "measured_original_robot_reference", "synthetic fixture cannot become a training demonstration")
            require(metadata.get("source_jump_validation") == "observed_jump_validated", "original jump reference validation pending")
        require(bool(np.all(abs(np.linalg.norm(states[:,3:7],axis=-1)-1)<.001)), "native quaternion must be unit wxyz")
        self.times_s=t; self.states=states.copy(); self.states[:,3:7]=continuous_quat(states[:,3:7])
        self.joint_names=tuple(joint_names); self.metadata=dict(metadata); self.allow_fixture=allow_fixture
        mask=np.asarray(metadata.get("conditioning_feature_mask73"),dtype=bool)
        require(mask.shape==(73,),"explicit packed-state conditioning mask73 required")
        self.conditioning_mask73=mask
        dt=metadata.get("target_control_dt_s")
        require(isinstance(dt,(int,float)) and np.isfinite(dt) and dt>0,"explicit positive target control clock required")
        phase=metadata.get("partial_phase_contract")
        if phase is not None:
            require(phase.get("schema")=="mod4.supermimic.partial_step270_phase_contract.v1","unknown partial phase contract")
            fields=["demo_height_vz_active_through_reference_time_s","own_task_step_edge_x_m","own_task_platform_height_m",
                    "own_task_nominal_chassis_height_m","own_task_support_region_transition_m"]
            require(all(isinstance(phase.get(k),(int,float)) and np.isfinite(phase[k]) for k in fields),"non-finite/missing phase support geometry")
            require(t[0]<=phase[fields[0]]<t[-1] and all(phase[k]>0 for k in fields[2:]),"invalid phase cutoff/support geometry")

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls,data,*,allow_fixture=False):
        require(data.get("schema")==NATIVE_SCHEMA,"wrong native reference schema")
        require(set(data)=={"schema","times_s","packed73","joint_names","metadata"},"unexpected native reference fields")
        return cls(data["times_s"],data["packed73"],data["joint_names"],data["metadata"],allow_fixture=allow_fixture)

    def as_dict(self):
        return dict(schema=NATIVE_SCHEMA,times_s=self.times_s.tolist(),packed73=self.states.tolist(),
                    joint_names=list(self.joint_names),metadata=self.metadata)

    def _for_named_joint_order(self,joint_names,*,actual_sdk_readback):
        names=tuple(joint_names)
        require(len(names)==30 and len(set(names))==30 and set(names)==set(self.joint_names), "native SDK joint names mismatch")
        ids=np.array([self.joint_names.index(n) for n in names]); out=self.states.copy()
        out[:,13:43]=self.states[:,13+ids]; out[:,43:73]=self.states[:,43+ids]
        mask=self.conditioning_mask73.copy()
        mask[13:43]=self.conditioning_mask73[13+ids];mask[43:73]=self.conditioning_mask73[43+ids]
        meta=dict(self.metadata,sdk_joint_order_verified=bool(actual_sdk_readback),
                  offline_joint_order_verified=not actual_sdk_readback,
                  joint_mapping_evidence="actual_runtime_robot_joint_names" if actual_sdk_readback else "offline_named_geometry_CPU_contract_only",
                  conditioning_feature_mask73=mask.tolist())
        if "joint_position_range_scale30" in meta:
            meta["joint_position_range_scale30"]=array(meta["joint_position_range_scale30"],(30,),"joint range scales")[ids].tolist()
        return NativeReference(self.times_s,out,names,meta,allow_fixture=self.allow_fixture)

    def for_sdk_joint_order(self,sdk_joint_names):
        """Runtime owner must pass the ACTUAL robot.joint_names before first step/Pi."""
        return self._for_named_joint_order(sdk_joint_names,actual_sdk_readback=True)

    def for_offline_joint_order(self,offline_joint_names):
        """Truthful offline named mapping; does not claim SDK readback or allow GPU."""
        return self._for_named_joint_order(offline_joint_names,actual_sdk_readback=False)

    def align_control_clock(self,*,native_frame_anchor,reference_time_anchor_s):
        """Explicit reviewed phase alignment; no reading of future plant gates/actions."""
        require(np.isfinite(native_frame_anchor) and np.isfinite(reference_time_anchor_s),"finite reference clock anchors required")
        require(self.times_s[0]<=reference_time_anchor_s<=self.times_s[-1],"reference clock anchor outside clip")
        offset=float(reference_time_anchor_s)-float(native_frame_anchor)*float(self.metadata["target_control_dt_s"])
        meta=dict(self.metadata,native_frame_zero_reference_time_s=offset,
                  clock_alignment=dict(native_frame_anchor=float(native_frame_anchor),reference_time_anchor_s=float(reference_time_anchor_s),
                                       uses_future_actions_or_gate_choices=False))
        return NativeReference(self.times_s,self.states,self.joint_names,meta,allow_fixture=self.allow_fixture)

    def at_time(self,query_times_s):
        """Explicit hold at both endpoints; interpolate only retargeted states."""
        q=np.asarray(query_times_s,dtype=float); require(bool(np.isfinite(q).all()),"non-finite query")
        clipped=np.clip(q,self.times_s[0],self.times_s[-1])
        lo=np.clip(np.searchsorted(self.times_s,clipped,side="right")-1,0,len(self.times_s)-2)
        alpha=(clipped-self.times_s[lo])/(self.times_s[lo+1]-self.times_s[lo])
        result=(1-alpha[...,None])*self.states[lo]+alpha[...,None]*self.states[lo+1]
        result[...,3:7]=slerp(self.states[lo,3:7],self.states[lo+1,3:7],alpha)
        return result

    def goal_frames_numpy(self,frames,num_frames,control_dt_s):
        require(num_frames>=1 and isinstance(num_frames,int),"positive integer goal window required")
        require(np.isfinite(control_dt_s) and control_dt_s>0,"positive native control clock required")
        f=np.asarray(frames,dtype=float)
        offset=float(self.metadata.get("native_frame_zero_reference_time_s",0.))
        goals=[]
        for i in range(num_frames):
            query=(f+i)*control_dt_s+offset
            goal=self.at_time(query)*self.conditioning_mask73
            phase=self.metadata.get("partial_phase_contract")
            if phase is not None:
                active=query<=phase["demo_height_vz_active_through_reference_time_s"]
                goal[...,2]*=active;goal[...,9]*=active
            goals.append(goal)
        return np.concatenate(goals,-1)

    def torch_provider(self,device="cpu",*,allow_fixture=False,offline_cpu_only=False):
        if offline_cpu_only:
            require(str(device)=="cpu" and self.metadata.get("offline_joint_order_verified") is True,
                    "offline CPU provider requires explicit offline named mapping and CPU device")
        else:
            require(self.metadata.get("sdk_joint_order_verified") is True,"call for_sdk_joint_order(actual robot.joint_names) first")
        require(allow_fixture or not self.allow_fixture,"fixture torch provider requires explicit CPU test flag")
        return TorchReferenceGoalProvider(self,device,allow_fixture=allow_fixture,offline_cpu_only=offline_cpu_only)


class TorchReferenceGoalProvider:
    """Drop-in goal/reference source; imports torch only when explicitly instantiated.

    Add to an H1GoalMdp subclass and override goal() plus to(). Inherited native
    reward then calls the overridden goal, retaining the current reward coefficients.
    No WM replay write or hidden applied-action/gate inputs exist here.
    """
    goal_frame_dim=73

    def __init__(self,reference,device="cpu",*,allow_fixture=False,offline_cpu_only=False):
        import torch
        self._torch=torch; self.reference=reference; self.allow_fixture=allow_fixture;self.offline_cpu_only=offline_cpu_only
        require(not allow_fixture or str(device)=="cpu","synthetic contract fixtures are CPU only")
        require(not offline_cpu_only or str(device)=="cpu","offline named-order proof is CPU only")
        require(allow_fixture or reference.metadata.get("sdk_joint_order_verified") is True or
                (offline_cpu_only and reference.metadata.get("offline_joint_order_verified") is True),
                "provider requires actual SDK order or explicitly offline CPU named proof")
        self.times=torch.as_tensor(reference.times_s,dtype=torch.float32,device=device)
        self.states=torch.as_tensor(reference.states,dtype=torch.float32,device=device)
        self.mask=torch.as_tensor(reference.conditioning_mask73,dtype=torch.float32,device=device)
        self.control_dt_s=float(reference.metadata["target_control_dt_s"])
        self.first_time_s=float(reference.times_s[0]);self.last_time_s=float(reference.times_s[-1])
        # The retarget producer exports a uniform native control grid. Index it
        # directly: float32 frame->seconds roundoff must not create fractional
        # mixing at exact sample frames, especially for differentiated q/dq.
        self.uniform_control_grid=bool(np.allclose(np.diff(reference.times_s),self.control_dt_s,rtol=0,atol=1e-9))
        self.frame_zero_offset=(float(reference.metadata.get("native_frame_zero_reference_time_s",0.))-self.first_time_s)/self.control_dt_s

    def to(self,device):
        return TorchReferenceGoalProvider(self.reference,device,allow_fixture=self.allow_fixture,offline_cpu_only=self.offline_cpu_only)

    def _evaluate(self,frames,num_frames,*,mask):
        torch=self._torch
        require(isinstance(num_frames,int) and num_frames>=1,"positive goal window required")
        require(frames.device==self.states.device,"reference and native frame device mismatch")
        if frames.is_floating_point():
            require(bool(torch.isfinite(frames).all()),"non-finite frame query")
        all_goals=[]
        for offset in range(num_frames):
            if self.uniform_control_grid:
                sample=(frames.float()+offset+self.frame_zero_offset).clamp(0,len(self.times)-1)
                lo=sample.floor().long().clamp(0,len(self.times)-2)
                a=(sample-lo)[...,None]
                times=self.first_time_s+sample*self.control_dt_s
            else:
                times=((frames.float()+offset)*self.control_dt_s+float(self.reference.metadata.get("native_frame_zero_reference_time_s",0.))).clamp(self.first_time_s,self.last_time_s)
                lo=(torch.searchsorted(self.times,times.contiguous(),right=True)-1).clamp(0,len(self.times)-2)
                a=((times-self.times[lo])/(self.times[lo+1]-self.times[lo]))[...,None]
            result=(1-a)*self.states[lo]+a*self.states[lo+1]
            first,second=self.states[lo,3:7],self.states[lo+1,3:7]
            dot=(first*second).sum(-1,keepdim=True)
            second=torch.where(dot<0,-second,second);dot=dot.abs().clamp(0,1)
            theta=torch.acos(dot);sine=torch.sin(theta)
            # Clamp only the inactive numerical denominator; no new physical gate.
            wa=torch.where(sine<1e-6,1-a,torch.sin((1-a)*theta)/sine.clamp_min(1e-12))
            wb=torch.where(sine<1e-6,a,torch.sin(a*theta)/sine.clamp_min(1e-12))
            result[...,3:7]=torch.nn.functional.normalize(wa*first+wb*second,dim=-1)
            if mask:
                result=result*self.mask
                phase=self.reference.metadata.get("partial_phase_contract")
                if phase is not None:
                    active=times<=float(phase["demo_height_vz_active_through_reference_time_s"])
                    result[...,2]*=active;result[...,9]*=active
            all_goals.append(result)
        return torch.cat(all_goals,-1)

    def goal(self,frames,num_frames):
        return self._evaluate(frames,num_frames,mask=True)

    def raw_reference_at_frames(self,frames,num_frames=1):
        return self._evaluate(frames,num_frames,mask=False)

    def reference_at_frames(self,frames,num_frames=1):
        return self.goal(frames,num_frames)


class ReferenceConditioningMdp:
    """Composition wrapper for a PARTIAL demonstration and the unchanged task MDP.

    Native goal() is a packed state, not invariant_features(). In the current H1
    implementation inherited reward() would track self.goal's world X/Y. Calling
    base.reward explicitly keeps its existing task objective, and avoids scoring
    an unobserved standing-jump forward path. Reference values condition the native
    policy; they are not forced actions, a new reward, or foreign WM transitions.

    The static mask is applied to goal channels; it is not concatenated, so the
    actor observation128/history10 and goal73 dimensions remain unchanged. The
    metadata carries the mask semantics. Do not unflatten a masked goal as a full
    physical state or use it as a WM target. Unmasked states remain in reference.
    """
    def __init__(self,base_mdp,provider):
        require(base_mdp.goal_frame_dim==73,"native base goal dimension changed")
        require(provider.reference.metadata.get("reference_role") in ("partial_jump_shape_conditioning_only","partial_jump_shape_reference"),
                "this wrapper is explicitly reviewed only for partial jump conditioning")
        self.base=base_mdp;self.provider=provider

    def __getattr__(self,name):
        return getattr(self.base,name)

    def to(self,device):
        return ReferenceConditioningMdp(self.base.to(device),self.provider.to(device))

    def goal(self,frames,num_frames):
        return self.provider.goal(frames,num_frames)

    def reference_at_frames(self,frames,num_frames=1):
        return self.goal(frames,num_frames)

    def reward(self,state,frames,action,previous_action):
        # Keep the method bound to base: base.reward's self.goal remains the task
        # objective, never the stationary foreign reference's world XY.
        return self.base.reward(state,frames,action,previous_action)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PartialImitationObjectiveConfig:
    """Reviewed formula candidate; runtime/loss admission is explicitly pending.

    Costs below are dimensionless after the named SI/range normalizations. They
    do not change the real V8 RewardManager and are not claimed trained weights.
    """
    own_task_x_weight: float=5.
    own_task_y_weight: float=5.
    demo_height_weight_per_m2: float=15.
    demo_orientation_frobenius_weight: float=2.
    demo_vertical_velocity_weight_per_m2_s2: float=.1
    demo_angular_velocity_weight_per_rad2_s2: float=.02
    demo_joint_position_range_weight: float=2.
    demo_joint_velocity_range_weight: float=.01
    joint_velocity_reference_timescale_s: float=.1
    action_change_weight: float=.001
    speed_regularization_weight: float=.001
    joint_speed_regularization_weight: float=.0001
    own_task_landing_height_weight_per_m2: float=15.
    admission: str="source_CPU_candidate_runtime_loss_admission_pending"


class PartialReferenceImitationMdp:
    """Actual partial-demo alignment in native imagination; physical V8 untouched.

    The old analytic root Z curve is NOT scored in this candidate. Own task X
    and Y progress remain separate task terms (the existing base.goal X and Y=0),
    never relabeled as Fudan motion. Demo alignment scores retargeted height,
    orientation, vertical/angular velocity and observed own leg q/dq only. World
    XY/XY velocity and unidentifiable wheel/roller spins are excluded from demo
    alignment. No future applied action or physical phase/gate is accepted.

    This replaces only native H1GoalMdp.reward's IMAGINATION SURROGATE when a caller
    deliberately installs it. It does not touch Bridge.step()/V8 RewardManager,
    real command/success, WM data source or architecture, policy inference, or
    physical sampling. The conditioning-only wrapper above is a preserved earlier
    alternative; it is not the proposed demonstration-transfer objective.
    """
    def __init__(self,base_mdp,provider,config=None):
        require(base_mdp.goal_frame_dim==73,"native goal73 required")
        require(provider.reference.metadata.get("reference_role") in ("partial_jump_shape_conditioning_only","partial_jump_shape_reference"),
                "partial jump objective requires an explicitly partial reference")
        self.base=base_mdp;self.provider=provider;self.config=config or PartialImitationObjectiveConfig()
        require(self.config.joint_velocity_reference_timescale_s>0,"positive joint velocity normalization timescale required")
        scales=array(provider.reference.metadata.get("joint_position_range_scale30"),(30,),"own joint position scale30")
        require(bool((scales>0).all()),"own joint range scales must be positive")
        self.joint_scale=provider._torch.as_tensor(scales,dtype=provider.states.dtype,device=provider.states.device)
        self.qmask=provider.mask[13:43]
        self.dqmask=provider.mask[43:73]
        require(bool((provider.mask[[0,1,7,8]]==0).all()),"partial demo cannot claim XY motion coverage")
        self.phase=provider.reference.metadata.get("partial_phase_contract")
        require(isinstance(self.phase,dict) and self.phase.get("schema")=="mod4.supermimic.partial_step270_phase_contract.v1",
                "partial step270 phase mask/support-height contract required; flat-return Z/vZ cannot supervise elevated landing")

    def __getattr__(self,name):return getattr(self.base,name)

    def to(self,device):
        return PartialReferenceImitationMdp(self.base.to(device),self.provider.to(device),self.config)

    def goal(self,frames,num_frames):return self.provider.goal(frames,num_frames)

    def reference_at_frames(self,frames,num_frames=1):return self.goal(frames,num_frames)

    def objective_terms(self,state,frames,action,previous_action):
        torch=self.provider._torch;c=self.config
        position,rotation,velocity,angular_velocity,joint_pos,joint_vel=state
        target=self.provider.raw_reference_at_frames(frames)
        task_target=self.base.goal(frames,1)
        own_task_forward=torch.exp(-c.own_task_x_weight*(position[...,0]-task_target[...,0]).square()
                                   -c.own_task_y_weight*position[...,1].square())
        w,x,y,z=target[...,3:7].unbind(-1)
        desired_rotation=torch.stack((1-2*(y*y+z*z),2*(x*y-w*z),2*(x*z+w*y),
                                      2*(x*y+w*z),1-2*(x*x+z*z),2*(y*z-w*x),
                                      2*(x*z-w*y),2*(y*z+w*x),1-2*(x*x+y*y)),-1).reshape(rotation.shape)
        query_time=frames.float()*self.provider.control_dt_s+float(self.provider.reference.metadata.get("native_frame_zero_reference_time_s",0.))
        ascent=(query_time<=float(self.phase["demo_height_vz_active_through_reference_time_s"])).to(position.dtype)
        height_cost=ascent*c.demo_height_weight_per_m2*(position[...,2]-target[...,2]).square()
        rotation_cost=c.demo_orientation_frobenius_weight*(rotation-desired_rotation).square().mean((-1,-2))
        vertical_velocity_cost=ascent*c.demo_vertical_velocity_weight_per_m2_s2*(velocity[...,2]-target[...,9]).square()
        angular_velocity_cost=c.demo_angular_velocity_weight_per_rad2_s2*(angular_velocity-target[...,10:13]).square().mean(-1)
        qcost=((joint_pos-target[...,13:43])/self.joint_scale).square()*self.qmask
        vscale=self.joint_scale/c.joint_velocity_reference_timescale_s
        dqcost=((joint_vel-target[...,43:73])/vscale).square()*self.dqmask
        joint_position_cost=c.demo_joint_position_range_weight*qcost.sum(-1)/self.qmask.sum().clamp_min(1)
        joint_velocity_cost=c.demo_joint_velocity_range_weight*dqcost.sum(-1)/self.dqmask.sum().clamp_min(1)
        demo_cost=height_cost+rotation_cost+vertical_velocity_cost+angular_velocity_cost+joint_position_cost+joint_velocity_cost
        demo_alignment=torch.exp(-demo_cost)
        edge=float(self.phase["own_task_step_edge_x_m"])
        width=float(self.phase["own_task_support_region_transition_m"])
        support_region=((position[...,0]-edge)/width).clamp(0,1)

        own_landing_height_cost=(1-ascent)*support_region*c.own_task_landing_height_weight_per_m2*(position[...,2]-own_landing_target).square()
        own_landing_alignment=torch.exp(-own_landing_height_cost)
        upright=((rotation[...,2,2]+1)*.5).clamp(0,1)
        regularization=c.action_change_weight*(action-previous_action).square().mean(-1)
        regularization=regularization+c.speed_regularization_weight*velocity.square().mean(-1)+c.joint_speed_regularization_weight*joint_vel.square().mean(-1)
        total=own_task_forward*own_landing_alignment*upright*demo_alignment-regularization
        return dict(total=total,own_task_forward=own_task_forward,demo_alignment=demo_alignment,
                    demo_height_cost=height_cost,demo_orientation_cost=rotation_cost,
                    demo_vertical_velocity_cost=vertical_velocity_cost,demo_angular_velocity_cost=angular_velocity_cost,
                    demo_joint_position_cost=joint_position_cost,demo_joint_velocity_cost=joint_velocity_cost,
                    demo_height_vz_active=ascent,own_task_landing_height_cost=own_landing_height_cost,
                    own_task_landing_alignment=own_landing_alignment,own_task_support_region_weight=support_region,
                    upright=upright,regularization=regularization)

    def reward(self,state,frames,action,previous_action):
        return self.objective_terms(state,frames,action,previous_action)["total"]

    def contract_manifest(self):
        """Metadata for root's save/admission protocol; does not write external state."""
        return dict(schema="mod4.supermimic.partial_reference_objective_contract.v2",
                    candidate_admission=self.config.admission,config=asdict(self.config),

                                       own_step_edge_x_m=.35,own_platform_height_m=.27,
                                       own_nominal_chassis_height_m,own_support_region_transition_m=.0637):

    values=[own_step_edge_x_m,own_platform_height_m,own_nominal_chassis_height_m,own_support_region_transition_m]
    require(np.isfinite(values).all() and own_platform_height_m>0 and own_nominal_chassis_height_m>0 and own_support_region_transition_m>0,
            "finite positive own support geometry required")
    phase=dict(schema="mod4.supermimic.partial_step270_phase_contract.v1",
               demo_height_vz_active_through_reference_time_s=float(measured_ascent_end_reference_time_s),
               demo_height_vz_after_ascent="excluded_from_conditioning_and_imagination_loss_source_returns_to_original_surface",
               measured_ascent_cutoff_basis="recorded_minimum_two_wheel_bottom_path_apex",

               own_task_nominal_chassis_height_m=float(own_nominal_chassis_height_m),
               own_task_support_region_transition_m=float(own_support_region_transition_m),
               own_task_landing_height_basis="separate_own_task_geometry_not_foreign_step_ascent_evidence",
               source_XY_forward_and_H1_step_ascent_coverage=False,
               physical_V8_reward_commands_success_unchanged=True)

              reference_reward_integration="PartialReferenceImitationMdp_v3_ascent_Z_Vz_mask_plus_separate_own_task_support_height",

"""Injected task contract for SuperMimic world-model training."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Protocol, runtime_checkable

import torch

State = tuple[
    torch.Tensor,
    torch.Tensor,
    torch.Tensor,
    torch.Tensor,
    torch.Tensor,
    torch.Tensor,
]

SUPERMIMIC_TRANSITION_KEY = "supermimic"
SUPERMIMIC_STATE_KEY = "supermimic_state"


@runtime_checkable
class SuperMimicMdpProtocol(Protocol):
    """Differentiable analytic heads and reference data owned by a task."""

    num_joints: int
    context_dim: int
    obs_dim: int
    goal_frame_dim: int
    max_step_reward: float

    def obs(
        self,
        state: State,
        previous_action: torch.Tensor,
        context: torch.Tensor,
        frames: torch.Tensor,
    ) -> torch.Tensor: ...

    def add_noise(self, obs: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor: ...

    def goal(self, frames: torch.Tensor, num_frames: int) -> torch.Tensor: ...

    def reward(
        self,
        state: State,
        frames: torch.Tensor,
        action: torch.Tensor,
        previous_action: torch.Tensor,
    ) -> torch.Tensor: ...

    def soft_termination(self, state: State, frames: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor: ...

    def critic_features(
        self,
        state: State,
        frames: torch.Tensor,
        normalized_context: torch.Tensor,
    ) -> torch.Tensor: ...

    def normalize_context(self, context: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor: ...

    def valid_imagination_start(self, frames: torch.Tensor, horizon: int) -> torch.Tensor: ...

    def to(self, device: str | torch.device) -> SuperMimicMdpProtocol:
        """Return a copy on ``device`` for learner-side use off the env device."""
        ...


@runtime_checkable
class SupportsSuperMimicProtocol(Protocol):
    """Environment exposing its task-owned SuperMimic implementation."""

    @property
    def supermimic_mdp(self) -> SuperMimicMdpProtocol: ...


def get_supermimic_mdp(env: Any) -> SuperMimicMdpProtocol:
    """Return the injected task MDP, failing closed for unsupported envs."""
    if not isinstance(env, SupportsSuperMimicProtocol):
        raise TypeError(f"{type(env).__name__} does not provide the SuperMimic MDP contract")
    return env.supermimic_mdp

    "SUPERMIMIC_TRANSITION_KEY",
    "State",
    "SuperMimicMdpProtocol",
    "SupportsSuperMimicProtocol",
    "get_supermimic_mdp",
]

"""Batched tensor geometry for SuperMimic (quaternions use wxyz)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F

from supermimic_vendor_v2.contract import State


def quat_to_mat(q: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    q = F.normalize(q, dim=-1)
    w, x, y, z = q.unbind(-1)
    return torch.stack(
        (
            1 - 2 * (y * y + z * z),
            2 * (x * y - w * z),
            2 * (x * z + w * y),
            2 * (x * y + w * z),
            1 - 2 * (x * x + z * z),
            2 * (y * z - w * x),
            2 * (x * z - w * y),
            2 * (y * z + w * x),
            1 - 2 * (x * x + y * y),
        ),
        dim=-1,
    ).reshape(q.shape[:-1] + (3, 3))


def mat_to_quat(m: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    m00, m01, m02 = m[..., 0, 0], m[..., 0, 1], m[..., 0, 2]
    m10, m11, m12 = m[..., 1, 0], m[..., 1, 1], m[..., 1, 2]
    m20, m21, m22 = m[..., 2, 0], m[..., 2, 1], m[..., 2, 2]
    qw = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(1 + m00 + m11 + m22, min=1e-10)) / 2
    qx = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(1 + m00 - m11 - m22, min=1e-10)) / 2
    qy = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(1 - m00 + m11 - m22, min=1e-10)) / 2
    qz = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(1 - m00 - m11 + m22, min=1e-10)) / 2
    candidates = torch.stack(
        (
            torch.stack(
                (qw, (m21 - m12) / (4 * qw), (m02 - m20) / (4 * qw), (m10 - m01) / (4 * qw)), -1
            ),
            torch.stack(
                ((m21 - m12) / (4 * qx), qx, (m01 + m10) / (4 * qx), (m02 + m20) / (4 * qx)), -1
            ),
            torch.stack(
                ((m02 - m20) / (4 * qy), (m01 + m10) / (4 * qy), qy, (m12 + m21) / (4 * qy)), -1
            ),
            torch.stack(
                ((m10 - m01) / (4 * qz), (m02 + m20) / (4 * qz), (m12 + m21) / (4 * qz), qz), -1
            ),
        ),
        dim=-2,
    )
    indices = torch.stack((qw, qx, qy, qz), -1).argmax(-1)
    q = torch.gather(
        candidates, -2, indices[..., None, None].expand(indices.shape + (1, 4))
    ).squeeze(-2)
    q = F.normalize(q, dim=-1)
    return q * torch.where(q[..., :1] < 0, -1.0, 1.0)


def axis_angle_to_mat(axis: torch.Tensor, angle: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    x, y, z = axis.unbind(-1)
    cos, sin = torch.cos(angle), torch.sin(angle)
    complement = 1 - cos
    return torch.stack(
        (
            cos + x * x * complement,
            x * y * complement - z * sin,
            x * z * complement + y * sin,
            y * x * complement + z * sin,
            cos + y * y * complement,
            y * z * complement - x * sin,
            z * x * complement - y * sin,
            z * y * complement + x * sin,
            cos + z * z * complement,
        ),
        dim=-1,
    ).reshape(angle.shape + (3, 3))


def skew(vector: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    x, y, z = vector.unbind(-1)
    zero = torch.zeros_like(x)
    return torch.stack((zero, -z, y, z, zero, -x, -y, x, zero), -1).reshape(
        vector.shape[:-1] + (3, 3)
    )


def so3_exp(vector: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    theta2 = (vector * vector).sum(-1, keepdim=True)
    theta = torch.sqrt(theta2 + 1e-12)
    small = theta2 < 1e-8
    a = torch.where(small, 1 - theta2 / 6, torch.sin(theta) / theta)
    b = torch.where(small, 0.5 - theta2 / 24, (1 - torch.cos(theta)) / (theta2 + 1e-12))
    skew_matrix = skew(vector)
    eye = torch.eye(3, device=vector.device, dtype=vector.dtype).expand(skew_matrix.shape)
    return eye + a[..., None] * skew_matrix + b[..., None] * (skew_matrix @ skew_matrix)


def quat_to_rotvec(q: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    q = q * torch.where(q[..., :1] < 0, -1.0, 1.0)
    vector = q[..., 1:]
    sin_half = torch.linalg.norm(vector, dim=-1, keepdim=True)
    half = torch.atan2(sin_half, q[..., :1])
    scale = torch.where(
        sin_half < 1e-6,
        2.0 / torch.clamp(q[..., :1], min=1e-6),
        2 * half / (sin_half + 1e-12),
    )
    return vector * scale


def so3_log(rotation: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    return quat_to_rotvec(mat_to_quat(rotation))


def rot_angle_sq(first: torch.Tensor, second: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    trace = (first * second).sum((-1, -2))
    cosine = torch.clamp((trace - 1) / 2, -1 + 1e-6, 1 - 1e-6)
    return torch.acos(cosine) ** 2


def yaw_mat(rotation: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    forward_x, forward_y = rotation[..., 0, 0], rotation[..., 1, 0]
    norm = torch.sqrt(forward_x * forward_x + forward_y * forward_y + 1e-9)
    cos, sin = forward_x / norm, forward_y / norm
    zero, one = torch.zeros_like(cos), torch.ones_like(cos)
    return torch.stack((cos, -sin, zero, sin, cos, zero, zero, zero, one), -1).reshape(
        rotation.shape[:-2] + (3, 3)
    )


def mat_to_6d(rotation: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    return rotation[..., :, :2].reshape(rotation.shape[:-2] + (6,))


def quat_slerp(first: torch.Tensor, second: torch.Tensor, t: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    dot = (first * second).sum(-1, keepdim=True)
    second = torch.where(dot < 0, -second, second)
    dot = dot.abs().clamp(max=1.0)
    theta = torch.acos(dot)
    sin = torch.sin(theta)
    t = t[..., None]
    first_weight = torch.where(sin < 1e-6, 1 - t, torch.sin((1 - t) * theta) / (sin + 1e-12))
    second_weight = torch.where(sin < 1e-6, t, torch.sin(t * theta) / (sin + 1e-12))
    return F.normalize(first_weight * first + second_weight * second, dim=-1)


def flatten_state(state: State) -> torch.Tensor:
    position, rotation, lin_vel, ang_vel, joint_pos, joint_vel = state
    return torch.cat((position, mat_to_quat(rotation), lin_vel, ang_vel, joint_pos, joint_vel), -1)


def unflatten_state(value: torch.Tensor) -> State:
    num_joints = (value.shape[-1] - 13) // 2
    joint_end = 13 + num_joints
    return (
        value[..., 0:3],
        quat_to_mat(value[..., 3:7]),
        value[..., 7:10],
        value[..., 10:13],
        value[..., 13:joint_end],
        value[..., joint_end:],
    )


def invariant_features(state: State) -> torch.Tensor:
    position, rotation, lin_vel, ang_vel, joint_pos, joint_vel = state
    heading = yaw_mat(rotation)
    rotation_t = rotation.transpose(-1, -2)
    return torch.cat(
        (
            position[..., 2:3],
            mat_to_6d(heading.transpose(-1, -2) @ rotation),
            (rotation_t @ lin_vel.unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1),
            (rotation_t @ ang_vel.unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1),
            joint_pos,
            joint_vel,
        ),
        -1,
    )

    q = q * torch.where(q[..., :1] < 0, -1.0, 1.0)
    vector = q[..., 1:]
    sin_half = torch.linalg.norm(vector, dim=-1, keepdim=True)
    half = torch.atan2(sin_half, q[..., :1])
    scale = torch.where(
        sin_half < 1e-6,
        2.0 / torch.clamp(q[..., :1], min=1e-6),
        2 * half / (sin_half + 1e-12),
    )
    return vector * scale


def so3_log(rotation: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    return quat_to_rotvec(mat_to_quat(rotation))


def rot_angle_sq(first: torch.Tensor, second: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    trace = (first * second).sum((-1, -2))
    cosine = torch.clamp((trace - 1) / 2, -1 + 1e-6, 1 - 1e-6)
    return torch.acos(cosine) ** 2


def yaw_mat(rotation: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    forward_x, forward_y = rotation[..., 0, 0], rotation[..., 1, 0]
    norm = torch.sqrt(forward_x * forward_x + forward_y * forward_y + 1e-9)
    cos, sin = forward_x / norm, forward_y / norm
    zero, one = torch.zeros_like(cos), torch.ones_like(cos)
    return torch.stack((cos, -sin, zero, sin, cos, zero, zero, zero, one), -1).reshape(
        rotation.shape[:-2] + (3, 3)
    )


def mat_to_6d(rotation: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    return rotation[..., :, :2].reshape(rotation.shape[:-2] + (6,))


def quat_slerp(first: torch.Tensor, second: torch.Tensor, t: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    dot = (first * second).sum(-1, keepdim=True)
    second = torch.where(dot < 0, -second, second)
    dot = dot.abs().clamp(max=1.0)
    theta = torch.acos(dot)
    sin = torch.sin(theta)
    t = t[..., None]
    first_weight = torch.where(sin < 1e-6, 1 - t, torch.sin((1 - t) * theta) / (sin + 1e-12))
    second_weight = torch.where(sin < 1e-6, t, torch.sin(t * theta) / (sin + 1e-12))
    return F.normalize(first_weight * first + second_weight * second, dim=-1)


def flatten_state(state: State) -> torch.Tensor:
    position, rotation, lin_vel, ang_vel, joint_pos, joint_vel = state
    return torch.cat((position, mat_to_quat(rotation), lin_vel, ang_vel, joint_pos, joint_vel), -1)


def unflatten_state(value: torch.Tensor) -> State:
    num_joints = (value.shape[-1] - 13) // 2
    joint_end = 13 + num_joints
    return (
        value[..., 0:3],
        quat_to_mat(value[..., 3:7]),
        value[..., 7:10],
        value[..., 10:13],
        value[..., 13:joint_end],
        value[..., joint_end:],
    )


def invariant_features(state: State) -> torch.Tensor:
    position, rotation, lin_vel, ang_vel, joint_pos, joint_vel = state
    heading = yaw_mat(rotation)
    rotation_t = rotation.transpose(-1, -2)
    return torch.cat(
        (
            position[..., 2:3],
            mat_to_6d(heading.transpose(-1, -2) @ rotation),
            (rotation_t @ lin_vel.unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1),
            (rotation_t @ ang_vel.unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1),
            joint_pos,
            joint_vel,
        ),
        -1,
    )


__all__ = [
    "axis_angle_to_mat",

    "mat_to_quat",
    "quat_slerp",
    "quat_to_mat",
    "quat_to_rotvec",
    "rot_angle_sq",
    "skew",
    "so3_exp",
    "so3_log",
    "unflatten_state",
    "yaw_mat",
]

"""SuperMimic training over the injected environment and MDP protocols."""

@dataclass

    wm_batches: int = 10
    wm_batch: int = 2048

def _empty_stats() -> dict[str, list[torch.Tensor]]:
    return {"r": [], "ep_len": [], "ep_ret": [], "term": [], "done": []}


def _set_requires_grad(module: nn.Module, enabled: bool) -> None:
    for parameter in module.parameters():
        parameter.requires_grad_(enabled)


class SuperMimicLearner:
    def __init__(
        self,
        env: EnvProtocol,
        cfg: SuperMimicConfig,
        log_dir: str | Path,
        device: str | torch.device | None = None,
        backend: str = "",
    ):
        if cfg.amp not in ("none", "bf16"):
            raise ValueError(f"amp must be 'none' or 'bf16', got {cfg.amp!r}")
        if cfg.utd <= 0:
            raise ValueError("utd must be positive")
        if cfg.test_hidden_dims is not None and not cfg.test_hidden_dims:
            raise ValueError("test_hidden_dims must be nonempty when provided")

        self.env = env
        self.cfg = cfg
        self.backend = backend
        self.log_dir = Path(log_dir)
        self.log_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.env_device = torch.device(env.device)
        self.device = self.env_device if device is None else torch.device(device)
        # HOST_BRIDGE backends (e.g. MuJoCo) keep env tensors on CPU while the
        # learner may run on an accelerator (MPS on macOS); when the two differ,
        # the learner works on its own MDP copy and bridges tensors at the env
        # boundary. On CUDA/ROCm the devices always match and nothing changes.
        self._bridged = self.device != self.env_device
        mdp = get_supermimic_mdp(env)
        self.mdp = mdp.to(self.device) if self._bridged else mdp

        # TF32 only pays off for fp32 (amp="none") training: under bf16 autocast
        # the heavy GEMMs already run in bf16, while on ROCm a TF32 bmm over the
        # misaligned strided views produced by unflatten_state triggers per-call
        # rocBLAS kernel selection costing ~100 ms per call.
        torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = cfg.amp == "none"
        torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32 = True
        torch.manual_seed(cfg.seed)
        networks.AMP_DTYPE = torch.bfloat16 if cfg.amp == "bf16" else None

        self.wm = self._make_world_model().to(self.device)
        self.pi = self._make_policy().to(self.device)
        self.critic = Critic(self._critic_input_dim(), hidden=cfg.critic_hidden).to(self.device)
        if cfg.test_hidden_dims is not None:
            self.critic.net = mlp(self.critic.norm.mean.numel(), cfg.test_hidden_dims, 1).to(
                self.device
            )
        self.opt_wm = torch.optim.Adam(self.wm.parameters(), lr=cfg.lr)
        self.opt_pi = torch.optim.Adam(self.pi.parameters(), lr=cfg.lr, betas=(0.9, 0.95))
        self.opt_v = torch.optim.Adam(self.critic.parameters(), lr=cfg.lr)

        self.buffer = ReplayBuffer(
            cfg.buffer_steps,
            env.num_envs,
            self.device,
            num_joints=self.mdp.num_joints,
            context_dim=self.mdp.context_dim,
            action_dim=getattr(self.mdp,"action_dim",self.mdp.num_joints),
        )
        self.obs_hist = torch.zeros(env.num_envs, cfg.hist, self.mdp.obs_dim, device=self.device)
        self.err_floor = torch.cat(
            (
                torch.full((3,), 3e-3),
                torch.full((3,), 5e-3),
                torch.full((3,), 2e-2),
                torch.full((3,), 5e-2),
                torch.full((self.mdp.num_joints,), 3e-3),
                torch.full((self.mdp.num_joints,), 5e-2),
            )
        ).to(self.device)

        self.iteration = 0
        self.sim_steps = 0
        self.wall_time = 0.0
        self.stats = _empty_stats()
        self._wm_rollout_fn = self._compile(self._wm_rollout)
        self._wm_err_fn = self._compile(self._wm_err)
        self._imag_step_fn = self._compile(self._imag_step)
        self._reward_term_fn = self._compile(self._reward_term)
        self._critic_input_fn = self._compile(self._critic_input)

        with (self.log_dir / "args.json").open("w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            json.dump(asdict(cfg), stream, indent=2)

    def _compile(self, function):
        if not self.cfg.compile:
            return function
        if self.device.type == "mps":
            # Inductor Metal codegen is not usable on MPS; keep AOT graph
            # capture without kernel generation.
            return torch.compile(function, backend="aot_eager")
        return torch.compile(function)

    def _make_world_model(self) -> WorldModel:
        kwargs = {
            "num_joints": self.mdp.num_joints,
            "context_dim": self.mdp.context_dim,
            "action_dim": getattr(self.mdp,"action_dim",self.mdp.num_joints),
        }
        if self.cfg.test_hidden_dims is not None:
            return WorldModel(hidden=self.cfg.test_hidden_dims, **kwargs)
        return WorldModel(hidden=self.cfg.wm_hidden, **kwargs)

    def _make_policy(self) -> Policy:
        goal_dim = self.mdp.goal_frame_dim * self.cfg.goal_frames
        policy = Policy(
            self.mdp.obs_dim,
            goal_dim,
            hist=self.cfg.hist,
            z_dim=self.cfg.z_dim,
            num_joints=getattr(self.mdp,"action_dim",self.mdp.num_joints),
            hidden=self.cfg.policy_hidden,
        )
        if self.cfg.test_hidden_dims is not None:
            enc_output = policy.enc[-1]
            assert isinstance(enc_output, nn.Linear)
            z_dim = enc_output.out_features
            policy.enc = mlp(goal_dim, self.cfg.test_hidden_dims, z_dim)
            policy.dec = mlp(
                z_dim + self.mdp.obs_dim * self.cfg.hist,
                self.cfg.test_hidden_dims,
                getattr(self.mdp,"action_dim",self.mdp.num_joints),
            )
            dec_output = policy.dec[-1]
            assert isinstance(dec_output, nn.Linear)
            with torch.no_grad():
                dec_output.weight.mul_(0.01)
                dec_output.bias.zero_()
        return policy

    def _state_info(self) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
        state = self.env.state
        if state is None:
            state = self.env.init_state()
        info: dict[str, torch.Tensor] = state.info[SUPERMIMIC_STATE_KEY]
        if self._bridged:
            info = {key: value.to(self.device) for key, value in info.items()}
        return info

    def _critic_input_dim(self) -> int:
        info = self._state_info()
        with torch.no_grad():
            features = self.mdp.critic_features(
                unflatten_state(info["s"]),
                info["f"],
                self.mdp.normalize_context(info["xi"]),
            )
        return int(features.shape[-1] + self.mdp.goal_frame_dim * self.cfg.goal_frames)

    def _wm_rollout(
        self, states: torch.Tensor, actions: torch.Tensor, contexts: torch.Tensor
    ) -> State:
        state = unflatten_state(states[:, 0])
        predictions = []
        for index in range(self.cfg.wm_window):
            state = self.wm.step(
                state,
                actions[:, index],
                self.mdp.normalize_context(contexts[:, index]),
            )
            predictions.append(state)
        return (
            torch.stack([prediction[0] for prediction in predictions], 1),
            torch.stack([prediction[1] for prediction in predictions], 1),
            torch.stack([prediction[2] for prediction in predictions], 1),
            torch.stack([prediction[3] for prediction in predictions], 1),
            torch.stack([prediction[4] for prediction in predictions], 1),
            torch.stack([prediction[5] for prediction in predictions], 1),
        )

    def _wm_err(
        self, predicted: State, next_states: torch.Tensor, mask: torch.Tensor
    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
        std = torch.maximum(self.wm.out_norm.std(), self.err_floor)
        error = (self.wm.state_error(predicted, unflatten_state(next_states)) / std) ** 2
        error = error.mean(-1)
        return (error * mask).sum() / next_states.shape[0], error[:, -1]

    def _imag_step(
        self,
        state: State,
        obs_hist: torch.Tensor,
        previous_action: torch.Tensor,
        frames: torch.Tensor,
        context: torch.Tensor,
        normalized_context: torch.Tensor,
        goal: torch.Tensor,
    ) -> tuple[State, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
        action = torch.clamp(self.pi(obs_hist, goal), -6, 6)
        next_state = self.wm.step(state, action, normalized_context)
        next_frames = frames + 1
        obs = self.mdp.add_noise(self.mdp.obs(next_state, action, context, next_frames))
        next_hist = torch.cat((obs_hist[:, 1:], obs.unsqueeze(1)), 1)
        next_goal = self.mdp.goal(next_frames, self.cfg.goal_frames)
        return next_state, action, next_hist, next_frames, next_goal

    def _reward_term(
        self,
        state: State,
        frames: torch.Tensor,
        action: torch.Tensor,
        previous_action: torch.Tensor,
    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
        return self.mdp.reward(state, frames, action, previous_action), self.mdp.soft_termination(
            state, frames
        )

    def _critic_input(
        self,
        state: State,
        frames: torch.Tensor,
        normalized_context: torch.Tensor,
        goal: torch.Tensor,
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        return torch.cat((self.mdp.critic_features(state, frames, normalized_context), goal), -1)

    @torch.no_grad()
    def collect(self, n_steps: int) -> None:
        for _ in range(n_steps):
            info = self._state_info()
            state = unflatten_state(info["s"])
            obs = self.mdp.add_noise(self.mdp.obs(state, info["a_prev"], info["xi"], info["f"]))
            fresh = info["ep_step"] == 0
            shifted = torch.cat((self.obs_hist[:, 1:], obs.unsqueeze(1)), 1)
            self.obs_hist = torch.where(
                fresh[:, None, None], obs.unsqueeze(1).expand_as(self.obs_hist), shifted
            )
            goal = self.mdp.goal(info["f"], self.cfg.goal_frames)
            self.pi.obs_norm.update(obs)
            self.pi.goal_norm.update(goal)
            if hasattr(self.env,"before_action"):
                self.env.before_action()
            action = self.pi(self.obs_hist, goal)
            action = torch.clamp(action + self.cfg.action_noise * torch.randn_like(action), -20, 20)
            if self._bridged:
                step_state = self.env.step(action.to(self.env_device))
            else:
                step_state = self.env.step(action)
            transition = step_state.info[SUPERMIMIC_TRANSITION_KEY]
            if self._bridged:
                transition = {key: value.to(self.device) for key, value in transition.items()}
            self.buffer.add(transition)
            initial = unflatten_state(transition["s"])
            next_state = unflatten_state(transition["s1"])
            self.wm.in_norm.update(
                self.wm.inputs(
                    initial,
                    transition["a"],
                    self.mdp.normalize_context(transition["xi"]),
                )
            )
            self.wm.out_norm.update(self.wm.targets(initial, next_state))
            self.sim_steps += self.env.num_envs
            self.stats["r"].append(transition["r"].mean() / self.mdp.max_step_reward)
            if "ep_len" in transition:
                self.stats["ep_len"].append(transition["ep_len"].mean())
                self.stats["ep_ret"].append(transition["ep_ret_norm"].mean())
                self.stats["term"].append(transition["term"].float().sum())
                self.stats["done"].append(transition["done"].float().sum())

    def wm_update(self) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
        window = self.buffer.sample_windows(self.cfg.wm_batch, self.cfg.wm_window)
        predicted = self._wm_rollout_fn(window["s"], window["a"], window["xi"])
        loss, last_error = self._wm_err_fn(predicted, window["s1"], window["mask"])
        self.opt_wm.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
        loss.backward()
        nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(self.wm.parameters(), 1.0)
        self.opt_wm.step()
        mask = window["mask"][:, -1]
        mean_last_error = (last_error.detach() * mask).sum() / mask.sum().clamp(min=1)
        return loss.detach() / self.cfg.wm_window, mean_last_error

    def _sample_valid_starts(
        self, batch_size: int
    ) -> tuple[dict[str, torch.Tensor], dict[str, torch.Tensor]]:
        starts = []
        histories = []
        count = 0
        while count < batch_size:
            start, history = self.buffer.sample_starts(2 * batch_size, self.cfg.hist)
            valid = self.mdp.valid_imagination_start(start["f"], self.cfg.horizon)
            indices = valid.nonzero(as_tuple=False).squeeze(-1)[: batch_size - count]
            starts.append({key: value[indices] for key, value in start.items()})
            histories.append({key: value[indices] for key, value in history.items()})
            count += len(indices)

        def concatenate(parts: list[dict[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
            return {key: torch.cat([part[key] for part in parts]) for key in parts[0]}

        return concatenate(starts), concatenate(histories)

    def policy_update(
        self,
    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
        start, history = self._sample_valid_starts(self.cfg.pi_batch)
        state = unflatten_state(start["s"])
        context, frames, previous_action = start["xi"], start["f"], start["a_prev"]
        normalized_context = self.mdp.normalize_context(context)
        with torch.no_grad():
            obs_hist = self.mdp.obs(
                unflatten_state(history["s"]),
                history["a_prev"],
                history["xi"],
                history["f"],
            )
        obs_hist = self.mdp.add_noise(obs_hist)
        _set_requires_grad(self.wm, False)
        _set_requires_grad(self.critic, False)

        batch_size = self.cfg.pi_batch
        initial_goal = self.mdp.goal(frames, self.cfg.goal_frames)
        goal = initial_goal
        initial_state = state
        states, actions, previous_actions, all_frames, goals = [], [], [], [], []
        try:
            for _ in range(self.cfg.horizon):
                previous_actions.append(previous_action)
                state, previous_action, obs_hist, frames, goal = self._imag_step_fn(
                    state,
                    obs_hist,
                    previous_action,
                    frames,
                    context,
                    normalized_context,
                    goal,
                )
                states.append(state)
                actions.append(previous_action)
                all_frames.append(frames)
                goals.append(goal)

            def flatten(parts: list[torch.Tensor]) -> torch.Tensor:
                return torch.stack(parts).flatten(0, 1)

            all_states = cast(
                State, tuple(flatten([item[index] for item in states]) for index in range(6))
            )
            flat_frames = flatten(all_frames)
            rewards, dones = self._reward_term_fn(
                all_states, flat_frames, flatten(actions), flatten(previous_actions)
            )
            rewards = rewards.view(self.cfg.horizon, batch_size)
            dones = dones.view(self.cfg.horizon, batch_size)
            alive = torch.cumprod(1 - dones, 0)
            continuation = torch.cat((torch.ones(1, batch_size, device=self.device), alive[:-1]), 0)
            discount = self.cfg.gamma ** torch.arange(
                self.cfg.horizon, device=self.device, dtype=torch.float32
            ).unsqueeze(-1)
            objective = (discount * continuation * rewards).sum(0)
            survival = alive[-1]
            reward_sum = (continuation * rewards).detach().sum(0)
            detached_rewards, detached_dones = rewards.detach(), dones.detach()
            if not self.cfg.no_critic:
                objective = objective + (self.cfg.gamma**self.cfg.horizon) * survival * self.critic(
                    self._critic_input_fn(state, frames, normalized_context, goal)
                )
            loss = -objective.mean()
            self.opt_pi.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
            loss.backward()
            grad_norm = nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(self.pi.parameters(), 1.0)
            nn.utils.clip_grad_value_(self.pi.parameters(), 0.1)
            if torch.isfinite(grad_norm):
                self.opt_pi.step()
        finally:
            _set_requires_grad(self.wm, True)
            _set_requires_grad(self.critic, True)

        value_loss = torch.zeros((), device=self.device)
        if not self.cfg.no_critic:
            with torch.no_grad():
                critic_states = cast(
                    State,
                    tuple(
                        torch.cat(
                            (
                                initial_state[index].unsqueeze(0),
                                torch.stack([item[index].detach() for item in states]),
                            ),
                            0,
                        ).flatten(0, 1)
                        for index in range(6)
                    ),
                )
                critic_frames = torch.cat(
                    (start["f"].unsqueeze(0), torch.stack(all_frames)), 0
                ).flatten()
                critic_goals = torch.cat(
                    (initial_goal.unsqueeze(0), torch.stack(goals)), 0
                ).flatten(0, 1)
                critic_context = (
                    normalized_context.unsqueeze(0)
                    .expand(self.cfg.horizon + 1, -1, -1)
                    .flatten(0, 1)
                )
                critic_input = self._critic_input_fn(
                    critic_states, critic_frames, critic_context, critic_goals
                ).view(self.cfg.horizon + 1, batch_size, -1)
            self.critic.norm.update(critic_input)
            with torch.no_grad():
                values = self.critic(critic_input)
                target = values[-1]
                targets = []
                for index in range(self.cfg.horizon - 1, -1, -1):
                    target = detached_rewards[index] + self.cfg.gamma * (
                        1 - detached_dones[index]
                    ) * ((1 - self.cfg.lam) * values[index + 1] + self.cfg.lam * target)
                    targets.append(target)
                targets = torch.stack(targets[::-1])
            flat_input = critic_input[:-1].reshape(-1, critic_input.shape[-1])
            flat_targets = targets.reshape(-1)
            num_samples = flat_input.shape[0]
            minibatch_size = num_samples // self.cfg.critic_minibatches
            if minibatch_size == 0:
                raise ValueError("critic_minibatches exceeds the number of imagined transitions")
            for _ in range(self.cfg.critic_epochs):
                permutation = torch.randperm(num_samples, device=self.device)
                for index in range(self.cfg.critic_minibatches):
                    indices = permutation[index * minibatch_size : (index + 1) * minibatch_size]
                    value_loss = (
                        (self.critic(flat_input[indices]) - flat_targets[indices]) ** 2
                    ).mean()
                    self.opt_v.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
                    value_loss.backward()
                    nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(self.critic.parameters(), 1.0)
                    self.opt_v.step()

        imagined_reward = (reward_sum / self.cfg.horizon / self.mdp.max_step_reward).mean()
        return (
            loss.detach(),
            value_loss.detach(),
            imagined_reward,
            grad_norm.detach(),
            survival.mean().detach(),
        )

    def lr_at(self, iteration: int) -> float:
        if iteration >= self.cfg.lr_decay_iters:
            return self.cfg.lr * 0.03
        return self.cfg.lr * (
            0.03 + 0.97 * 0.5 * (1 + math.cos(math.pi * iteration / self.cfg.lr_decay_iters))
        )

    def _checkpoint(self, include_optimizers: bool) -> dict[str, Any]:
        checkpoint = {
            "wm": self.wm.state_dict(),
            "pi": self.pi.state_dict(),
            "iteration": self.iteration,
            "wall_time": self.wall_time,
            "sim_steps": self.sim_steps,
            "args": asdict(self.cfg),
            "saved_at": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
        }
        if include_optimizers:
            checkpoint.update(
                {
                    "critic": self.critic.state_dict(),
                    "opt_wm": self.opt_wm.state_dict(),
                    "opt_pi": self.opt_pi.state_dict(),
                    "opt_v": self.opt_v.state_dict(),
                }
            )
        return checkpoint

    def save(self, path: str | Path | None = None, include_optimizers: bool = True) -> Path:
        destination = Path(path) if path is not None else self.log_dir / "last.pt"
        destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        temporary = destination.with_name(destination.name + ".tmp")
        torch.save(self._checkpoint(include_optimizers), temporary)
        os.replace(temporary, destination)
        return destination

    def load(self, path: str | Path) -> None:
        checkpoint = torch.load(path, map_location=self.device, weights_only=True)
        required = {"critic", "opt_wm", "opt_pi", "opt_v"}
        missing = sorted(required - checkpoint.keys())
        if missing:
            raise ValueError(
                f"SuperMimic resume requires a full last.pt checkpoint; missing {missing} in {path}"
            )
        self.wm.load_state_dict(checkpoint["wm"])
        self.pi.load_state_dict(checkpoint["pi"])
        self.critic.load_state_dict(checkpoint["critic"])
        self.opt_wm.load_state_dict(checkpoint["opt_wm"])
        self.opt_pi.load_state_dict(checkpoint["opt_pi"])
        self.opt_v.load_state_dict(checkpoint["opt_v"])
        self.iteration = checkpoint["iteration"]
        self.wall_time = checkpoint["wall_time"]
        self.sim_steps = checkpoint["sim_steps"]

    @staticmethod
    def _mean(values: list[torch.Tensor]) -> float:
        return float(sum(float(value) for value in values) / max(len(values), 1))

    def train(self, resume: str | Path | None = None) -> dict[str, float | int | bool]:
        if resume is not None:
            self.load(resume)
        start_iteration = self.iteration
        self.stats = _empty_stats()
        logger = SuperMimicLogger(
            env_name=type(self.env).__name__,
            backend=self.backend,
            max_iterations=self.cfg.iterations,
            wm_only_iters=self.cfg.wm_only_iters,
            start_iteration=start_iteration,
            num_envs=self.env.num_envs,
            log_dir=str(self.log_dir),
            log_backend=self.cfg.log_backend,
        )
        logger.start(status="Warming up...")
        try:
            if start_iteration == 0:
                self.collect(self.cfg.warmup_steps)
            required_steps = max(self.cfg.hist, self.cfg.wm_window)
            if start_iteration > 0:
                required_steps = max(required_steps, self.cfg.warmup_steps)
            if self.buffer.size < required_steps:
                self.collect(required_steps - self.buffer.size)
            logger.log_buffer_fill(self.buffer.size, self.cfg.buffer_steps)
            logger.start_training_timer()

            log_path = self.log_dir / "train_log.csv"
            with log_path.open("a", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as log_file:
                if start_iteration == 0:
                    log_file.write(",".join(_LOG_FIELDS) + "\n")
                train_start = time.time() - self.wall_time
                log_start = time.time()
                step_accumulator = 0.0
                aggregate: dict[str, list[torch.Tensor]] = {
                    key: [] for key in ("wm", "wm8", "pi", "v", "ir", "gn", "surv")
                }
                last_metrics: dict[str, float | int] = {}
                for iteration in range(start_iteration, self.cfg.iterations):
                    if self.cfg.compile and iteration == start_iteration:
                        logger.log_status("Compiling world model (one-off, slow on first run)")
                    if self.cfg.compile and iteration == self.cfg.wm_only_iters:
                        logger.log_status("Compiling policy update (one-off, slow on first run)")
                    iteration_start = time.time()
                    learning_rate = self.lr_at(iteration)
                    for optimizer in (self.opt_wm, self.opt_pi, self.opt_v):
                        for group in optimizer.param_groups:
                            group["lr"] = learning_rate
                    step_accumulator += 1.0 / self.cfg.utd
                    collect_steps = int(step_accumulator)
                    step_accumulator -= collect_steps
                    stats_mark = len(self.stats["r"])
                    self.collect(collect_steps)
                    train_phase_start = time.time()
                    wm_loss = torch.zeros((), device=self.device)
                    wm_error = torch.zeros((), device=self.device)
                    for _ in range(self.cfg.wm_batches):
                        wm_loss, wm_error = self.wm_update()
                    aggregate["wm"].append(wm_loss)
                    aggregate["wm8"].append(wm_error)
                    pi_loss: float | None = None
                    v_loss: float | None = None
                    imag_rew: float | None = None
                    pi_gradnorm: float | None = None
                    imag_survival: float | None = None
                    if iteration >= self.cfg.wm_only_iters:
                        policy_loss, value_loss, imagined_reward, grad_norm, survival = (
                            self.policy_update()
                        )
                        aggregate["pi"].append(policy_loss)
                        aggregate["v"].append(value_loss)
                        aggregate["ir"].append(imagined_reward)
                        aggregate["gn"].append(grad_norm)
                        aggregate["surv"].append(survival)
                        pi_loss = float(policy_loss)
                        v_loss = float(value_loss)
                        imag_rew = float(imagined_reward)
                        pi_gradnorm = float(grad_norm)
                        imag_survival = float(survival)
                    train_time = time.time() - train_phase_start
                    self.iteration = iteration + 1
                    self.wall_time = time.time() - train_start
                    iteration_time = time.time() - iteration_start

                    iter_rewards = self.stats["r"][stats_mark:]
                    mean_reward = self._mean(iter_rewards) if iter_rewards else None
                    ep_len = self._mean(self.stats["ep_len"]) if self.stats["ep_len"] else None
                    ep_ret_norm = self._mean(self.stats["ep_ret"]) if self.stats["ep_ret"] else None
                    total_done = sum(float(value) for value in self.stats["done"])
                    term_frac = (
                        sum(float(value) for value in self.stats["term"]) / total_done
                        if total_done > 0
                        else None
                    )
                    logger.log_step(
                        self.iteration,
                        wm_loss=float(wm_loss),
                        wm_err8=float(wm_error),
                        pi_loss=pi_loss,
                        v_loss=v_loss,
                        imag_rew=imag_rew,
                        imag_survival=imag_survival,
                        pi_gradnorm=pi_gradnorm,
                        lr=learning_rate,
                        sim_rew=mean_reward,
                        ep_len=ep_len,
                        ep_ret_norm=ep_ret_norm,
                        term_frac=term_frac,
                        iter_sim_steps=collect_steps * self.env.num_envs,
                        collect_time=train_phase_start - iteration_start,
                        learn_time=train_time,
                        iteration_time=iteration_time,
                    )

                    if self.iteration % self.cfg.log_every == 0:
                        iterations_per_second = self.cfg.log_every / (time.time() - log_start)
                        log_start = time.time()
                        term_frac = float(
                            sum(float(value) for value in self.stats["term"])
                            / max(sum(float(value) for value in self.stats["done"]), 1)
                        )
                        row = [
                            self.iteration,
                            self.wall_time / 3600,
                            self.sim_steps,
                            self._mean(aggregate["wm"]),
                            self._mean(aggregate["wm8"]),
                            self._mean(aggregate["pi"]),
                            self._mean(aggregate["v"]),
                            self._mean(aggregate["ir"]),
                            self._mean(aggregate["gn"]),
                            self._mean(aggregate["surv"]),
                            self._mean(self.stats["r"]),
                            self._mean(self.stats["ep_len"]),
                            self._mean(self.stats["ep_ret"]),
                            term_frac,
                            iterations_per_second,
                            learning_rate,
                        ]
                        log_file.write(
                            ",".join(
                                f"{value:.6g}" if isinstance(value, float) else str(value)
                                for value in row
                            )
                            + "\n"
                        )
                        log_file.flush()
                        last_metrics = dict(zip(_LOG_FIELDS, row, strict=True))
                        self.stats = _empty_stats()
                        aggregate = {key: [] for key in aggregate}

                    if (
                        self.iteration % self.cfg.ckpt_every == 0
                        or self.iteration == self.cfg.iterations
                    ):
                        self.wall_time = time.time() - train_start
                        self.save()
                        numbered = self.save(
                            self.log_dir / f"ckpt_{self.iteration:06d}.pt",
                            include_optimizers=False,
                        )
                        logger.log_save(str(numbered))

            self.wall_time = time.time() - train_start
            logger.finish()
            return {
                "completed": self.iteration >= self.cfg.iterations,
                "iteration": self.iteration,
                "sim_steps": self.sim_steps,
                "wall_time": self.wall_time,
                **last_metrics,
            }
        finally:
            logger.close()
